title: Act: Create worker module and config loader
summary: Add backend/worker go.mod, config package and example YAML
description: Create the module and the config LoadFS mirroring backend/internal/config/config.go.
acceptance_criteria: config.LoadFS fills defaults and applies env overrides

steps.action: Create go.mod declaring module github.com/worldseed/storyforge/worker, go 1.22, requiring gopkg.in/yaml.v3 v3.0.1; copy the yaml.v3 and gopkg.in/check.v1 lines from backend/go.sum into backend/worker/go.sum.
steps.code:
module github.com/worldseed/storyforge/worker

go 1.22

require gopkg.in/yaml.v3 v3.0.1
steps.expected: go list ./... in backend/worker resolves the module

steps.symbol: new: Config, WorkerConfig, LogConfig, StoreConfig, Load, LoadFS, applyEnv
steps.action: Define Config{Worker WorkerConfig `yaml:"worker"`; Log LogConfig `yaml:"log"`; Store StoreConfig `yaml:"store"`}; WorkerConfig{WorldID, RepoPath string; PollInterval, ExecutionTimeout time.Duration; MaxRetries int}; LogConfig{Level string}; StoreConfig{Dir, LockPath string}. LoadFS(fsys fs.FS, name string, getenv func(string) string) reads with fs.ReadFile, yaml.Unmarshal, applyEnv (STORYFORGE_WORKER_REPO_PATH -> Worker.RepoPath, STORYFORGE_WORKER_WORLD_ID -> Worker.WorldID), returns error 'config: worker.repo_path must not be empty' when RepoPath is empty, then defaults: PollInterval 30s, ExecutionTimeout 30m, MaxRetries 2 (when 0), Log.Level 'info', Store.Dir '.storyforge/executions', Store.LockPath '.storyforge/worker.lock', WorldID 'the-boys-room'. Load(path) calls LoadFS(os.DirFS(filepath.Dir(path)), filepath.Base(path), os.Getenv).
steps.code: func LoadFS(fsys fs.FS, name string, getenv func(string) string) (*Config, error)
steps.expected: Package compiles and mirrors the backend loader

steps.action: Add YAML with worker.world_id the-boys-room, worker.repo_path '.', poll_interval 30s, execution_timeout 30m, max_retries 2, log.level info, store.dir .storyforge/executions, store.lock_path .storyforge/worker.lock.
